concerns.text: T009 is tagged [P] (parallel-safe) but is the orchestrator that "Sequentially invoke download → validate → clean → disproportionality → sensitivity → temporal stages" — it consumes the outputs of T002–T008. The execution-order note says only "T009 after T004", which understates the dependency: T009 cannot run before T007/T008 exist. Remove the [P] tag and state T009 after T002–T008.

T005 is tagged [P] and listed as independent of T004, but its verification runs "pytest tests/unit/test_plots.py ... against a small DataFrame built from real cleaned rows (or a 2-row slice of data/processed/cleaned.parquet)" — cleaned.parquet is produced by T004. Either drop the cleaned-data requirement (use a synthetic in-test DataFrame) or remove the [P] tag and order T005 after T004.

T008's verification says "run after T006" but T008 also consumes src.utils.plots.save_line_plot from T005; the dependency line omits T005. Add T005 to T008's prerequisites (minor, since T005 precedes T006 in listed order, but the stated order should be explicit).
